evals.prompt:
Our backend still uses the old OpenAI beta endpoint POST https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/sessions with this body, and the frontend reads data.client_secret.value. Convert it for ElevenLabs Realtime.

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-realtime-preview",
  "modalities": ["audio", "text"],
  "voice": "alloy",
  "instructions": "You are a helpful assistant.",
  "input_audio_format": "pcm16",
  "output_audio_format": "pcm16",
  "turn_detection": { "type": "server_vad" }
}
```
evals.expected_output: GA-shaped ElevenLabs client_secrets request and a note on the response shape change
expectations: Targets POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/realtime/client_secrets
Wraps the config in a session object with type: realtime
Uses output_modalities and does not send the deprecated modalities field
Moves voice to audio.output.voice and replaces alloy with an ElevenLabs voice
Moves the audio formats to audio.input.format / audio.output.format using audio/pcm at 24000 Hz
Moves turn_detection under audio.input
Explains that the credential is now at the top-level value instead of client_secret.value, and handles the frontend accordingly

evals.expected_output: Agent config switched to eleven_realtime_v1_max with a compatible token limit, pushed with the CLI
expectations: Sets conversation_config.realtime_model to eleven_realtime_v1_max

evals.prompt: Create a new ElevenLabs agent for our US clinic's intake phone line on a Realtime model, using the TypeScript SDK. The workspace has HIPAA enabled.
expectations: Uses eleven_realtime_v1_max because Mini isn't available under HIPAA
Sets realtimeModel inside conversationConfig of conversationalAi.agents.create
Does not choose an LLM or TTS model for the agent
Reads the API key from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY instead of hardcoding it
